_meta.purpose: Consolidated master evaluation dataset fulfilling professor's Task 4 (50-100 question evaluation set across 12 categories) and Task 5 (ground truth: expected answer, relevant documents/chunks, answerable, authority level, official-vs-citizen).
_meta.sourcing_method: All relevant_chunk entries below were located by direct keyword search + manual reading of corpus_v2_chunks.jsonl (1,266 chunks). idx = 0-based line number in corpus_v2_chunks.jsonl. Questions Q001-Q020 consolidate and correct the earlier stek_eval_ground_truth_template.json (chunk_ids now filled in, replacing TO_VERIFY placeholders) and stek_task6_ground_truth.json (10 IR-metric queries, reformatted into this schema). Questions Q021-Q050 are new, added to fill category and quota gaps.
_meta.important_caveat: Ground truth is pragmatic and keyword-search-derived, not an exhaustive manual annotation of all 1,266 chunks per question. Treat relevant_chunks lists as a floor, not a ceiling — additional relevant chunks likely exist beyond what targeted search surfaced. This must be stated wherever Precision@k/Recall@k figures derived from this file are reported.
_meta.completeness_status: 45 of 50 questions have verified relevant_chunks (real idx from corpus_v2_chunks.jsonl, confirmed via direct search). 5 remain without chunks, of which 0 are answerable-but-unverified (should be 0 if this pass is complete) and 5 are correctly empty by design (vague/unanswerable categories, where no relevant chunk should exist). One question (Q011) was revised during this verification pass — the original claim about PHV tram access could not be confirmed in the source text and was replaced with a verified alternative.

schema.expected_answer: 2-3 sentence gold summary, grounded in real source text
schema.relevant_documents: document_id values of the chunks primarily supporting the answer
schema.relevant_chunks: list of {idx, chunk_id, document_id} — idx is the 0-based line number in corpus_v2_chunks.jsonl
schema.answerable: true/false — can the corpus answer this at all
schema.expected_authority_level: 1 (official strategy) to 4 (consultation/citizen) per the corpus's actual DAT levels; null if not applicable (vague/unanswerable)
schema.is_official_policy: true = represents committed city policy; false = citizen/participant opinion; null if not applicable

_meta.reverification_status: relevant_chunks remapped onto chunks_v2_meta.jsonl. Every answerable question is assigned the best-matching chunk per cited document, and carries a 'remap_confidence': HIGH = a distinctive number from expected_answer is literally present (number-verified, trustworthy); MED = matched on a rare word or strong word overlap (spot-check advised); LOW = weak word overlap only (review); NONE = no lexical overlap in the cited document (left empty). Each chunk entry has idx (line no.), chunk_id, chunk_uid, document_id and authority_level from the corpus. MED/LOW/NONE questions and alternative candidates are listed in gt_remap_review.txt.
_meta.expansion_note: Expanded from 50 to 60 questions — 4 new answerable questions (Q051-Q054, verified directly against raw source text) plus 6 new unanswerable/vague questions (Q055-Q060) to help meet Task 8's 10-20 target.
